sources.title: SQLite isolation
sources.released_version_or_commit: SQLite official living documentation; WAL supported since 3.7.0 (2010-07-21)
sources.observed_operation: Reopened the SQLite isolation page; inspected transaction isolation, WAL read-transaction snapshot behavior, rollback-mode current default, and the shared-cache/read_uncommitted exception.
sources.governing_condition_default_or_exception: Separate connections see committed transactions; WAL read txn sees stable snapshot; rollback mode is current default; exception is shared cache plus read_uncommitted.
sources.applicability: Database-specific example of snapshot semantics; target DB is unknown.
sources.limits: DB snapshots do not pin external files.

reviser_review.observed_operation: Reopened official SQLite isolation documentation; confirmed WAL read-transaction snapshots, rollback mode as current default, and the shared-cache/read_uncommitted exception.
reviser_review.result: SQLite-specific example only; conditional on actual transaction setup and unrelated to external blob pinning.

sources.title: SQLite Online Backup API
sources.observed_operation: Reopened the SQLite Online Backup API; inspected snapshot-at-commencement statement, incremental read-lock behavior, source-write restart and possible noncompletion under frequent writes.
sources.governing_condition_default_or_exception: Incremental API releases read locks between steps; successful copy is snapshot from commencement; source writes can restart steps.
sources.applicability: Use only if target uses SQLite; alternative for point-in-time database view.
sources.limits: Not a portable project archive; may include unrelated data.

reviser_review.observed_operation: Reopened official SQLite Online Backup API documentation; checked snapshot-at-commencement semantics and incremental locking/restart behavior.
reviser_review.result: Conditional SQLite mechanism, not a portable project export or a pin for external attachment bytes.

sources.title: PostgreSQL transaction isolation
sources.observed_operation: Reopened PostgreSQL 18 transaction isolation docs; checked Repeatable Read snapshot behavior and its DB-specific scope.
sources.governing_condition_default_or_exception: Repeatable Read sees data committed before transaction start and successive reads see same snapshot; same guarantee is DB-specific.
sources.applicability: Example if target DB is PostgreSQL; supports avoiding independent paged reads as consistency guarantee.
sources.limits: Do not generalize to other DBs or cross-store files.

reviser_review.observed_operation: Reopened PostgreSQL 18 transaction isolation documentation, including Repeatable Read and the Read Committed contrast.
reviser_review.result: Stable snapshot only if the target uses PostgreSQL and the export uses that isolation level.

sources.title: RFC 8259 JSON
sources.observed_operation: Reopened RFC 8259; checked UTF-8 requirement and JSON interoperability guidance; confirmed it does not define NDJSON.
sources.governing_condition_default_or_exception: External JSON MUST be UTF-8; keys SHOULD be unique; parser may limit document size/depth/number/string ranges.
sources.applicability: Structured text records; NDJSON is a line-oriented application convention, not defined by this RFC.
sources.limits: No product schema or identifier rules.

reviser_review.observed_operation: Reopened RFC 8259 sections 4 and 8.1; checked unique object-name guidance and UTF-8 requirement.
reviser_review.result: Supports UTF-8 JSON and unique keys; RFC 8259 does not define NDJSON or require a record-per-line representation.

sources.title: RFC 3339 timestamps
sources.released_version_or_commit: RFC 3339, July 2002; RFC Editor says updated by RFC 9557
sources.observed_operation: Reopened RFC 3339 and RFC 9557; checked -00:00 distinction and timestamp update relationship.
sources.governing_condition_default_or_exception: Timestamp denotes an instant with UTC relationship; -00:00 means local offset unknown and differs from Z/+00:00; unqualified local time is not an interoperable instant.
sources.applicability: Use for actual instants; preserve date-only values separately and named time zone for local schedules.
sources.limits: Do not invent timezone semantics for naive dates.

reviser_review.observed_operation: Reopened RFC 3339 sections 4.2-4.4 and 5.6; checked numeric offset, -00:00, and unqualified local time semantics.
reviser_review.result: Preserve unknown offset distinctly; use RFC 3339 only when source semantics establish an instant; do not infer date-only or local-schedule meaning.

sources.title: PKWARE ZIP APPNOTE
sources.observed_operation: Reopened ZIP APPNOTE 6.3.10; checked streaming data descriptors, ZIP64 records, and central-directory/end records at archive end.
sources.governing_condition_default_or_exception: Data descriptors support streaming; central directory/end records complete archive; ZIP64 expands fields when classic limits are too small.
sources.applicability: Compare stream-to-destination ZIP64 with folder and tar/PAX outputs.
sources.limits: Final archive structure alone does not prove record coverage/authenticity.

reviser_review.observed_operation: Reopened PKWARE ZIP APPNOTE 6.3.10 sections 4.3.5-4.3.16; checked streaming data descriptors, per-file central-directory records, and ZIP64/end records.
reviser_review.result: Supports streamed member data and container-aware completion; central-directory metadata grows with entry count; does not choose the product's reader matrix.

sources.title: NIST Secure Hash Standard
sources.released_version_or_commit: FIPS 180-4 final 2015-08-04; revision planned per NIST page
sources.observed_operation: Reopened NIST FIPS 180-4 page; checked SHA-256 digest purpose and distinction from authentication.
sources.governing_condition_default_or_exception: Digest detects message change with high probability; algorithm spec does not itself sign archive.
sources.applicability: Use SHA-256 for byte length/digest checks; call it corruption detection, not authenticity.
sources.limits: Manifest hashes can be rewritten; trusted signature/key is separate.

reviser_review.observed_operation: Reopened NIST FIPS 180-4 publication page and planning note.
reviser_review.result: Digests detect message changes; a digest with editable data is not archive authentication.
